references.author: SilencerCo
references.title: How Do Suppressors Work?
references.used_for: Expanding muzzle gases and reduced flash with suppression.

art: Original procedural alpha sprites; no source photographs, footage or audio redistributed.
calibration: Stylized presentation profiles, not measured weapon-specific photometry. Brief warm flash followed by a softer dissipating gas plume. Suppressors reduce flash and move emission to the actual exit. Bows, pneumatic and energy ammunition receive no combustion flash. Native ammunition properties gate emission; confirmed Native shot serials gate spawning.
scope: Presentation only; no changes to projectiles, damage, ammunition or simulation timing.
